description: This file defines the PHPMailer class, a core component of the PHPMailer library for creating and sending emails in PHP. It includes constants, properties, and methods for configuring email headers, recipients, attachments, encoding, SMTP settings, and sending mechanisms. The class supports multiple transport methods such as mail(), sendmail, SMTP, and QMail, and provides functionalities for address validation, MIME encoding, DKIM signing, and more.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: Main class providing functionalities for email creation, configuration, and transport. Supports multiple sending methods, address validation, MIME encoding, DKIM signing, and detailed email property management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PHPMailer object, setting exception behavior and default debug output mode based on the execution environment.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Creates, prepares, and dispatches the email message via the configured transport mechanism.

methods.name: preSend
methods.description: Prepares the email message, including headers, body, validation, and signing, before actual transmission.

methods.name: postSend
methods.description: Executes the sending process based on the configured transporter (mail, SMTP, sendmail, etc.).

methods.name: mailSend
methods.description: Sends email using PHP's mail() function with proper headers and address formatting.

methods.name: sendmailSend
methods.description: Sends email via the configured sendmail or qmail executable, constructing the command with safe handling of envelope sender.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a recipient address to the 'To' list.

methods.name: addCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient address to the 'CC' list.

methods.name: addBCC
methods.description: Adds a recipient address to the 'BCC' list.

methods.name: addReplyTo
methods.description: Adds a reply-to address.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender's email address and name, optionally also setting the Sender envelope address.

methods.name: isHTML
methods.description: Sets the email content type to HTML or plain text.

methods.name: isSMTP
methods.description: Configures the mailer to use SMTP.

methods.name: setBoundaries
methods.description: Defines MIME boundaries for multipart messages.

methods.name: parseAddresses
methods.description: Parses and validates RFC822-style email address strings into structured arrays.

methods.name: validateAddress
methods.description: Validates whether a string appears to be a valid email address according to various patterns.

methods.name: idnSupported
methods.description: Checks if PHP environment supports Internationalized Domain Names (IDN) with required extensions.

methods.name: punyencodeAddress
methods.description: Converts an email address with an IDN domain to its ASCII (punycode) form if possible.

methods.name: mailSend
methods.description: Sends an email using PHP's mail() function, preparing headers and handling the recipient list, including fallback for no specified 'To' addresses, and manages envelope sender configuration.

methods.name: getSMTPInstance
methods.description: Returns an SMTP instance for SMTP operations, creating a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: setSMTPInstance
methods.description: Sets a specific SMTP object instance for SMTP operations.

methods.name: setSMTPXclientAttribute
methods.description: Sets an SMTP XCLIENT attribute if it is allowed; otherwise, returns false.

methods.name: getSMTPXclientAttributes
methods.description: Returns the current SMTP XCLIENT attributes.

methods.name: smtpSend
methods.description: Sends message data via SMTP, managing connection, recipient addresses, headers, and data transmission, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: smtpConnect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an SMTP server, supporting multiple hosts, SSL/TLS, and authentication, with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: smtpClose
methods.description: Closes the SMTP connection if it is active.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for error messages, loading language files if available.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Returns the current language strings array, defaulting to English if not set.

methods.name: addrAppend
methods.description: Creates a header string for multiple recipient addresses.

methods.name: addrFormat
methods.description: Formats an individual email address and optional name into a header-compatible string.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text to specified line length, supporting UTF-8 and quoted-printable modes.

methods.name: utf8CharBoundary
methods.description: Finds the boundary in a UTF-8 encoded string to prevent splitting multibyte characters during line wrapping.

methods.name: setWordWrap
methods.description: Applies word wrapping to the message body or alternative body based on WordWrap property.

methods.name: createHeader
methods.description: Assembles email message headers including date, recipients, subject, message ID, priority, mailer, and custom headers.

methods.name: getMailMIME
methods.description: Returns MIME headers for the message, supporting multipart types and encoding.

methods.name: getSentMIMEMessage
methods.description: Returns the complete MIME message including headers and body.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Creates a unique boundary ID for MIME parts.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Builds the message body with support for multiple MIME structures, encoding, attachments, and optional signing with OpenSSL.

methods.name: getBoundaries
methods.description: Retrieves or sets message MIME boundaries.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Constructs a MIME boundary block with headers.

methods.name: endBoundary
methods.description: Creates the closing boundary marker for MIME parts.

methods.name: setMessageType
methods.description: Sets the message type based on existing content: alternative, inline images, attachments.

methods.name: headerLine
methods.description: Formats a single header line with name and value.

methods.name: textLine
methods.description: Creates a header or text line terminated with newline.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Attaches a file or string as an email attachment, with support for encoding and MIME type detection.

methods.name: getAttachments
methods.description: Returns array of current attachments.

methods.name: attachAll
methods.description: Generates MIME parts for all attachments matching the specified disposition and boundary.

methods.name: encodeFile
methods.description: Encodes a file as a MIME attachment with the specified encoding.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string according to the specified encoding: base64, quoted-printable, or 7bit/8bit.

methods.name: encodeHeader
methods.description: Encodes header values using RFC2047, choosing the shortest encoding (Q or B) and folding if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeBreaks
methods.description: Normalizes line breaks in a string to the standard format.

methods.name: has8bitChars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains 8-bit characters.

methods.name: hasLineLongerThanMax
methods.description: Detects if the string has lines exceeding maximum length.

methods.name: base64EncodeWrapMB
methods.description: Encodes multibyte strings to base64 with proper line wrapping.

methods.name: encodeQ
methods.description: Performs quoted-printable encoding on a string for header encoding.

methods.name: base64EncodeWrapMB
methods.description: Encodes multibyte strings to base64 with proper line wrapping, supporting UTF-8 and encoding within MIME headers.

methods.name: hasMultiBytes
methods.description: Checks whether a string contains multi-byte characters, utilizing mb_strlen if available.

methods.name: has8bitChars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains 8-bit characters (byte values >=128).

methods.name: encodeQP
methods.description: Encodes a string into quoted-printable format according to RFC2045 section 6.7.

methods.name: encodeQ
methods.description: Performs RFC2047 Q-encoding for headers, escaping special characters and encoding non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: addStringAttachment
methods.description: Adds an in-memory string as an email attachment, with options for encoding, MIME type, and disposition.

methods.name: addEmbeddedImage
methods.description: Adds a file as an inline embedded image, supporting data validation, MIME type detection, and attachment options.

methods.name: addStringEmbeddedImage
methods.description: Adds an in-memory string as an inline embedded image, specifying content ID and optional MIME type.

methods.name: validateEncoding
methods.description: Validates if a given encoding string is supported for email attachments.

methods.name: cidExists
methods.description: Checks whether an inline attachment with a specific content ID exists.

methods.name: inlineImageExists
methods.description: Determines if there are any inline (embedded) images attached.

methods.name: attachmentExists
methods.description: Checks if any non-inline attachments are present.

methods.name: alternativeExists
methods.description: Checks if an alternative plain text body has been set.

methods.name: clearAllRecipients
methods.description: Clears all recipient address lists, including To, Cc, Bcc, and queued addresses.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Removes all file and string attachments from the message.

methods.name: clearCustomHeaders
methods.description: Removes all custom headers from the email message.

methods.name: clearCustomHeader
methods.description: Removes a specific custom header by name and optional value.

methods.name: replaceCustomHeader
methods.description: Replaces an existing custom header with a new value, matching by name.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the internal error tracking system, including SMTP error details if applicable.

methods.name: rfcDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted according to RFC 822.

methods.name: serverHostname
methods.description: Determines the server hostname, defaulting to 'localhost.localdomain' if detection fails.

methods.name: isValidHost
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid hostname or IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: addressHasUnicodeLocalPart
methods.description: Checks whether an email address contains Unicode characters in the local part.

methods.name: anyAddressHasUnicodeLocalPart
methods.description: Checks if any in a list of email addresses contains Unicode in the local part.

methods.name: needsSMTPUTF8
methods.description: Returns whether the message requires SMTPUTF8 support.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error or status message by key, loading defaults if necessary.

methods.name: getSmtpErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs a detailed SMTP error message including nested SMTP error details.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if any errors have been recorded.

methods.name: addCustomHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom header line to the email, supporting name-value pairs.

methods.name: getCustomHeaders
methods.description: Returns all custom headers set on the email message.

methods.name: createBody
methods.description: Constructs the MIME message body, supporting multipart, attachments, encoding, and optional signing.

methods.name: html2text
methods.description: Converts an HTML message to plain text, optionally using a custom conversion callback.

methods.name: msgHTML
methods.description: Creates an HTML message with embedded images, inline attachments, and a fallback plain text version.

methods.name: getToAddresses
methods.description: Returns the list of 'To' recipients.

methods.name: getCcAddresses
methods.description: Returns the list of 'Cc' recipients.

methods.name: getBccAddresses
methods.description: Returns the list of 'Bcc' recipients.

methods.name: getReplyToAddresses
methods.description: Returns the list of 'Reply-To' addresses.

methods.name: getAllRecipientAddresses
methods.description: Returns the master list of all recipients, including queued addresses.

methods.name: doCallback
methods.description: Invokes a user-defined callback function with email sending result and details.

methods.name: getOAuth
methods.description: Returns the OAuth token provider instance used for OAuth authentication.

methods.name: setOAuth
methods.description: Sets the OAuth token provider instance for the email.
